notes: Benchmarks are directional. Sources use different samples, attribution windows and account mixes.
For low-capital admission, use break-even CPC from your own contribution margin and observed CVR instead of assuming benchmark CPC is affordable.

google_search_ecommerce.strategy: Use exact/high-intent queries only after organic/free proof. Avoid broad discovery.

google_shopping.strategy: Paid validator after feed quality and free-listing proof; SKU-level margin gating.

google_free_listings.strategy: Default acquisition foundation for physical products.

pinterest.holiday_visual_search_growth_relative_to: 2.3x faster YoY on UK 2026 holiday page
pinterest.strategy: Default discovery surface for visual/giftable products. Create many high-quality variants from one product asset.

etsy.strategy: Use marketplace demand for personalized/giftable validation. Price fees into contribution.
